{"title":"Validate X API v2: filtered stream, mentions, DMs (capabilities, permissions, rate limits) + implementation & compliance guidance","content":"## Approach
We will reduce uncertainty first by validating current, authoritative X developer documentation for each capability area (filtered stream, mentions, DMs) and for platform compliance/policy constraints. Research is parallelized by capability area, then we do a single fan-in synthesis into an implementation recommendation (including fallback strategies where APIs are unavailable or restricted).

## Deliverables
- Verified endpoints per feature (names/paths), required auth context (app vs user), required scopes/permissions, product-tier constraints
- Current rate limits / connection limits / rule limits where applicable
- Clear recommendation for an implementation architecture (streaming vs polling, error/backoff, scaling)
- Compliance notes/checklist (data handling, display, retention, automation, user consent where required)

## Dependency structure
Four parallel validation tracks feed one final synthesis task.","tasks":[{"goal":"Validate X API v2 Filtered Stream: endpoints, rule limits, connection/throughput constraints, auth requirements/scopes, and rate limits; capture any tier-based restrictions and operational considerations (reconnect/backoff, keep-alive, delivery semantics).","tool_name":"spawn_sub_agent","depends_on":[]},{"goal":"Validate X API v2 Mentions retrieval: endpoints (e.g., user mentions timeline), required permissions/scopes and auth context, pagination/filters, and rate limits; identify viable alternatives if direct mentions endpoint access is constrained (e.g., search-based).","tool_name":"spawn_sub_agent","depends_on":[]},{"goal":"Validate X API v2 Direct Messages (DMs): available v2 endpoints (lookup/manage), app eligibility requirements, required auth context/scopes, conversation constraints, and rate limits; note any approval-only/enterprise-only limitations and migration caveats from v1.1.","tool_name":"spawn_sub_agent","depends_on":[]},{"goal":"Validate compliance/platform constraints relevant to filtered stream + mentions + DMs: Developer Agreement/Policy requirements, data storage/retention, redistribution/display requirements, automation and user-consent constraints (especially for DMs), and security/privacy expectations; compile actionable compliance checklist.","tool_name":"spawn_sub_agent","depends_on":[]},{"goal":"Synthesize findings into an implementation recommendation: proposed architecture (streaming + polling mix), permission/tier plan, rate-limit/backoff strategy, monitoring/alerting, and a compliance-by-design notes section; include explicit ‘can/can’t’ matrix per feature.","tool_name":"reasoning","depends_on":[0,1,2,3]}],"dependencies_graph":[{"task_idx":"0","depends_on":[]},{"task_idx":"1","depends_on":[]},{"task_idx":"2","depends_on":[]},{"task_idx":"3","depends_on":[]},{"task_idx":"4","depends_on":["0","1","2","3"]}],"join":"all"}
